difference: d = CRPS(without) - CRPS(with) per decision day, scoring_protocol.day_scores with grid_crps (mean over h = 1 to 5), positive when the back-fill helps. This is the orientation of the calibrated B2 - B1 values (benchmark minus candidate, the without arm standing for the benchmark).

interval.rule: ruling 1: scoring_protocol.paired_tests, the studentized stationary bootstrap, mean block 10, 10,000 draws, seed 726, Newey-West lag 10. Two-sided 90% interval of mean(d): [mean - Q95(t) * se, mean - Q05(t) * se] with Q the quantiles of the sorted t-draws. One-sided 95% lower bound: mean - Q95(t) * se. The plain percentile interval of #759 is reported only in the reconciliation table, as the superseded reading.
interval.applies_to: the headline and every regime, half-year, type and share-restricted group

critical_value.why_it_is_a_reference: ruling 5 calibrates c for confirmation windows of 60, 125 and 250 days, not for a development sample of about 1,900 days; it is shown beside the bootstrap bound as a reference and decides nothing
critical_value.orientation: reported under both, because which one is in force is Eleonora's (#830): (A) d = without - with, as above, lower bound mean - c * se, cost when mean + c * se is below zero; (B) the reverse difference with - without, whose lower bound is -(mean + c * se) and whose upper bound is -(mean - c * se). The page prints mean - c * se and mean + c * se, which carry both.

groups.regimes: the regimes of metadata/evaluation_splits.json, as in #759
groups.types: the pressure-day type of the lead-1 target, as in #759
groups.period_rule: the decision day's calendar date (2018 H1 is 2018-06-29, the first decision day, to 2018-06-30)
groups.minimum_days: a group with no more than 10 decision days (the Newey-West lag) is not tested; it is listed with its day count

mostly_imputed_fits.measure: for each refit of the with arm, the share of back-filled rows (date before 2018-04-03) among the rows of the training frame, and the share of imputed cells (a cell of a candidate input that is blank in the frame) among all candidate-input cells of the frame. A decision day takes the shares of the refit that forecasts it.
mostly_imputed_fits.primary_rule: (b) is the comparison on the decision days whose with-arm training frame holds at most 50% back-filled rows
mostly_imputed_fits.sensitivity_rule: the same comparison at 75% and 90%, declared with the primary one because the primary one may leave no 2018-19 day: with 899 back-filled rows the share is at most 50% only once the published rows number 899 or more
reported_for_each_share: the days above the share, pooled
mostly_imputed_fits.question_for_eleonora: the share is a threshold, and a threshold is hers. 50% is the example of the directive; 75% and 90% are added so that a 2018-19 reading exists; she may name another.

reading_rule.gain: the back-fill helps beyond the interval in a group when the one-sided 95% studentized lower bound of mean(d) is above zero
reading_rule.cost: the back-fill costs in a group when the upper end of the two-sided 90% studentized interval of mean(d) is below zero; the reference value is reported beside it (mean + c * se below zero)
reading_rule.kill_lines: one line per reading, labelled development: (1) 2018-19 as a whole, all days; (2) 2018-19 split into 2018 H1, 2018 H2, 2019 H1 and 2019 H2; (3) 2019 alone; (4) 2018-19 on the days at or under each declared share; (5) each regime and the pooled sample for a cost. Each line states whether a gain is shown (lower bound above zero), whether a cost is shown (upper end below zero) or neither. Whether H4's kill is read, and on which line, is Eleonora's.
reading_rule.not_re_read: H4's calibration clause (coverage moves by less than their interval) is not re-read: the coverage tables of #759 stand as published on the percentile interval and are not re-scored here

published_declaration: the back-filled rows stay off in every published declaration; nothing is published and no figure moves
variant_count: none new: the same two arms at the same five leads as #759, re-run
not_checked: any 2026 day (locked), the 2014-18 days as scored days, and any verdict under protocol v1
whether IORB and SOFR volume are admitted on back-filled rows (Eleonora's open question on #742); the walks read the admitted list as metadata/backfill_posting.json has it today
